obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary page canvas, nav background, terminal preview windows — the void that every other surface floats on

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary page surface, body backgrounds behind hero sections, footer base

onyx.$description: Onyx — Elevated card and panel surfaces — first step up from the canvas for product cards and testimonials

carbon.$description: Carbon — Mid-level surface for nested UI, secondary buttons, and tag/badge backgrounds

slate-deep.$description: Slate Deep — Highest neutral surface — hover states, elevated modals, and pill chip backgrounds

bone.$description: Bone — Primary text and headline color — warm off-white avoids the clinical feel of pure white on black

paper.$description: Paper — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash-light.$description: Ash Light — Secondary heading text, soft dividers, subtle borders on elevated cards

ash-mid.$description: Ash Mid — Body copy, secondary text, button text on dark fills, muted descriptions

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, captions, nav links at rest, metadata, timestamps

ash-mute.$description: Ash Mute — Sub-heading emphasis, medium-muted text where Ash feels too dim

iron.$description: Iron — Lowest-priority text, disabled labels, nav metadata

ink.$description: Ink — Near-black for fine borders, deep text on light fills, separator strokes

phosphor-violet.$description: Phosphor Violet — The only chromatic color in the system — decorative icon strokes, code accents, product mark highlights, and subtle borders. Never used for filled CTAs; it is a whisper, not a shout

matter-regular.$description: Matter Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

matter.$description: Primary display and UI typeface — a custom geometric sans with engineered proportions. Weight 400 carries body and nav, 600–700 escalates to subheadings and emphasis. Extreme negative tracking at large sizes (-0.04em at 56px) tightens headlines into a single visual mass. Free substitute: Inter or General Sans

geist-mono.$description: Monospace for code snippets, terminal output, and technical micro-copy inside buttons and tags. Free substitute: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono

matter-mono.$description: Companion monospace for inline code and signature terminal callouts — ties back to the primary type family visually. Free substitute: Berkeley Mono or IBM Plex Mono

inter.$description: Secondary body fallback for long-form content blocks, testimonial quotes, and support copy where Matter may not load. Tight tracking (-0.012 to -0.014em) matches Matter's geometric feel

system-ui-sans-serif.$description: Ultra-small UI labels (icon captions, footer micro-text) where system rendering is acceptable and loading a web font is wasteful
